newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bus fire kills 39 in China - Hong Kong paper.
newsitem.headline: Bus fire kills 39 in China - Hong Kong paper.

text.p: Thirty-nine people, including three children, died when a bus engine caught fire and flames raced through the vehicle as it travelled along a southern Chinese highway, the Hong Kong-based Ming Pao newspaper said on Friday.
The paper said there was no emergency escape door on the bus which was carrying 71 passengers between Shenzhen, near the Hong Kong border, and the provincial capital of Guangzhou.
Chinese transport officials were not immediately available for comment.
